<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Funerals of Qasem Soleimani]]
**During the funeral of [[Qasem Soleimani]] in his hometown of [[Kerman]], [[Iran]], at least 56 people are killed and 213 more are injured during a [[stampede]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/iran-qassem-soleimani-us-kerman-1.5417178 (CBC)]

;International relations
*[[2019–20 Persian Gulf crisis]], [[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Consultative Assembly]] formally designates the [[United States Department of Defense]] as a terrorist organization in response to the assassination of General [[Qasem Soleimani]] in a [[2020 Baghdad International Airport airstrike|targeted killing]] in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]]. Under the newly adopted bill, all [[United States Armed Forces]] personnel and [[The Pentagon|Pentagon]] employees are considered terrorists. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-01/07/c_138685013.htm (Xinhuanet)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/iran-designates-us-forces-terrorists-for-killing-general-12240474 (Channel News Asia)]
**[[Germany]] announces a partial withdrawal of the [[Bundeswehr]] troops positioned in [[Iraq]], citing security concerns. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-to-partially-withdraw-troops-from-iraq/a-51909308 (DW)]
**Canada's Chief of the Defence Staff General [[Jonathan Vance]] announces that some of its military personnel in [[Iraq]] will be moved to neighboring [[Kuwait]] over safety reasons. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security-canada/canada-says-some-troops-in-iraq-to-be-moved-temporarily-to-kuwait-for-safety-idUSKBN1Z622W (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] says there is a "desperate need" for practical ways to improve ties with North Korea and says he is ready to meet repeatedly with [[Kim Jong-un]] in [[Pyongyang]] if necessary. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-politics-moon/south-koreas-moon-cites-desperate-need-for-ways-to-improve-ties-with-north-idUSKBN1Z603B (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Japan issues an arrest warrant for former [[Nissan]] Chairman [[Carlos Ghosn]]'s wife Carole for allegedly lying in testimony. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nissan-ghosn-statement/japan-issues-arrest-warrant-for-ghosns-wife-looks-for-ways-to-bring-him-back-idUSKBN1Z6057 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[November 2019 Spanish general election]] 
**After a year of political deadlock, incumbent [[Prime Minister of Spain]] [[Pedro Sánchez (politician)|Pedro Sánchez]] is sworn in thanks to the support of left-wing parties and regional nationalists. He will form the first [[coalition government]] in the democratic era, with [[Podemos (Spanish political party)|Podemos]] and its leader [[Pablo Iglesias Turrión]] as Second [[Deputy Prime Minister of Spain|Deputy Prime Minister]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51019358 (BBC)]
